description: Guide users to create or revise custom CloudRobo pipelines for sim/teleop VLA model training data — generate validated pipeline.yaml drafts from natural-language requirements without hand-written YAML. Compose workflows from selected preset and workspace algorithm assets, with optional OBS processing operators. Offer sim/teleop conversion → cleaning → evaluation as an explicitly selected template (内置模板名：仿真/遥操VLA模型数据处理管线，版本式命名如 仿真/遥操VLA模型数据处理管线-26.10.0001), with dynamic operator discovery, CLI-only Agent task submission, artifact handoff and local Web monitoring via a Python SDK backend. Triggers include: 创建自定义管线, 引导配置管线, 帮我设计管线, 生成pipeline.yaml, 修改管线步骤, custom pipeline builder, 仿真数据处理, 遥操数据清洗, 数据管线, 数据转换, 数据清洗, 数据评测, 训练就绪数据, 仿真/遥操VLA模型数据处理管线, data pipeline, 打开管线监控, 打开监控网站, pipeline monitor, web monitor.
